title: Annotation API v2 image embedding response
description: Response body of POST /api/v2/embeddings/image/. The server sends every key listed here.

ts.description: UTC time at which the response was produced, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

id.description: The request `id`, otherwise `auto-0`. Not necessarily an Impresso content-item id.

model_id.description: Slug of the model that produced the embedding, the same `model_id` as the batch image-embeddings records. A new slug is issued whenever the model revision changes.

seconds.description: Processing time of the request, in seconds.
